question: A monthly subscription rises 7% every year. Roughly how many years until its price has doubled?
move: Divide 70 by any yearly growth rate to see when it doubles.
ask: Which of my regular bills is quietly growing a few per cent a year, and when will it double?
trap: About 14 years, adding 7% fourteen times to reach 100%.
hint: Divide 70 by the yearly rise in per cent.
steps: Rule of 70: doubling time ≈ 70 ÷ yearly growth in per cent.
source: Meadows et al., The Limits to Growth, 1972
reference: Meadows, Meadows, Randers & Behrens, The Limits to Growth, Universe Books, 1972
